answer.text:
The supplied excerpts are insufficient to determine which company had higher R&D intensity or the percentage-point difference. Intel’s FY2024 excerpt reports **R&D and MG&A combined** as 41.5% of revenue, not R&D alone; the R&D chart does not provide a readable figure in the excerpt. No NVIDIA FY2025 R&D or revenue figures are provided.

So the comparison—and its calculation—cannot be made from this evidence without inventing figures. [Intel 10-K, accession **0000050863-25-000009**, “Filing Summary,” chunk **14**]
